name: 7-T MRI steering
full_name: Ultrahigh-field magnetic guidewire steering inside a 7-T MRI scanner with a robotic MRI stage
group: Sitti, Physical Intelligence Department, Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
target_anatomy: endovascular under MRI: renal artery, type 1 aortic arch, common carotid and middle cerebral artery glass models (tiryaki2023_magnetic Fig. 7); ex vivo porcine kidney renal cavity (non-vascular, Fig. 8)
devices_driven: own guidewire: MRI-compatible glass fibre-optic rod core with NdFeB tip magnets (1 mm x 1 mm cylinders) in parallel, perpendicular, antiparallel or dual configurations; 900 um Teflon supporting catheter (tiryaki2023_magnetic Results)
n_dof_detail: robotic MRI stage: x, y and yaw; manual insertion and base twist (tiryaki2023_magnetic Results, Fig. 5A)
translation_detail: magnetic (tip steering by MRI main-field torque and fringe-field gradient); insertion by hand (tiryaki2023_magnetic Fig. 5A, Fig. 7)
rotation_detail: motorized stage moves and rotates the phantom relative to the main field; manual base twist (tiryaki2023_magnetic Results)
force_sensing: none during navigation (MRI-conditioned force sensor used only to calibrate magnet force)
haptics_leader: no: joystick / remote controller for the stage (tiryaki2023_magnetic Results)
imaging_compat: MRI (real-time 1-Hz FISP in the kidney test; tip seen as a 37 x 29 mm susceptibility artefact) (tiryaki2023_magnetic Fig. 8)
validation_detail: 3D glass vascular models with physiological flow (renal artery, aortic arch at 100 mL per beat, CCA, MCAs), access through a Teflon port 40 cm from the target (tiryaki2023_magnetic Fig. 7); 2D obstacle tasks with three targets (Fig. 5); ex vivo porcine kidney renal cavity under real-time MRI, guidewire through the urinary tract, not a vessel (Fig. 8)
key_numbers: 7 T; fringe gradients up to 20 T/m at the bore entrance; tip workspace 161 deg at 7 T (Fig. 3C); antiparallel magnet rotates up to 164 deg; platform rotation up to 48 deg needed in 2D tasks (tiryaki2023_magnetic Results)
sim_model: Cosserat rod model (20 segments) with a UHF magnetization model, used for guidewire design (tiryaki2023_magnetic Methods)
sim2real_detail: none found (model used for design, no trained controller)
